markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (52%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Severe blur flags this simulated frozen section as unreliable [F6], with probabilities split between InSitu and Invasive (46%) [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 52%, Invasive 46%, Benign 3%, Normal 0% | Nearly tied InSitu vs Invasive |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% target coverage) | Cannot separate InSitu from Invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged); 100% OOD (blur) | Suspect out-of-distribution input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent models disagree on class |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%), 2/5 Benign [F5] | Mixed InSitu and Benign neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce score (-0.44, +0.85 contribution) pushes toward invasive [F2] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Typical score (+0.24, +0.30 contribution); descriptive context only [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Below-average score (z=-0.31, -0.27 contribution) pulls from invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Low score (0.00, -0.26 contribution) pulls away from invasive · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-average score (z=-0.31, +0.20 contribution) nudges toward invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal_lobules and mitoses (0/20 spot-checks).

## Could be wrong if
- Severe blur (severity 3) obscures stromal invasion in high-risk regions 6, 2, 1, 7, and 10 (88%–97% risk).
- Blur mimics atypia; closest neighbor `BACH_0330` (78% similarity) is Benign, and recut or deeper levels may clarify.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 2, 1, 7, 10**: Inspect highest-risk zones (88%–97% risk) for true stromal invasion.
2. **Region 11**: Verify normal lobules and benign stroma directly; ignore the Unreliable lobule concept score.
3. **Regions 3, 4**: Check duct-confined atypia and TILs; defer margin call [F7] pending recut or deeper levels.
